title: Train two hidden ReLU neurons
description: You trace forward prediction and backpropagation through the small network.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You compute two weighted inputs, apply rectified linear unit activations, and combine them into y_pred. The loss averages squared residuals.
You compute output gradients for v1, v2, and c. Each output weight gradient uses its corresponding hidden activation.

steps.question: Which quantities control the gradient passed to each hidden neuron's input parameters?
steps.answer: Each hidden gradient multiplies dy_pred by its output weight and relu_derivative at its weighted input. Multiplying by x then gives the input-weight gradient.

steps.description: You update all seven parameters and print every hundred epochs. The recorded loss falls by epoch 100 and prints as 0.0000 from epoch 200 onward.
